resources.string: Use your Google name and email for your Community profile. Phone and location are not imported. Nearby sharing stays off until you choose it.
Google sign-in is not configured for this build. Add the Web client ID and register this app’s package and signing certificate in Google Cloud.
Sign-in cancelled. You can try again or continue without an account.
No Google account is available. Add an account in phone Settings and check Google Play services, then try again.
Google sign-in is unavailable on this phone. Update Google Play services and try again.
Google returned an incomplete account profile. Try signing in again.
Could not sign in. Check your connection and try again. If this continues, check this build’s Google OAuth configuration.
Signed out locally. Google’s account chooser could not be reset; try again when Google Play services is available.
